metadata.description: Agent skills that give a repository a LinkML data model, at its root or as a sidecar.

plugins.name: schema-sidecar
plugins.description: Two agent skills that give a repository a LinkML data model: linkml-sidecar installs a linkml-project-copier project, at the root of an empty repository or as a hidden .linkml/ sidecar beside the code of any other, and linkml-author turns its dummy schema into the real model and keeps it generated, documented and tested. A KTL knowledge bundle beside it is left to KTL.
